notes: Executed before the subsequent battle-cue feedback-only fix. The later four-case smoke receipt records final-hash coverage.

Earlier provisional Skill Shop rendering failure was fixed before this run. A previous silence fixture accidentally inherited two MP; it was corrected to declare three MP before testing the three-MP physical technique.
Declared local save fixtures establish level, area, resources and old-format save state; purchases, item use, skill learning, battle targeting, job changes and reloads use actual player UI.

This is bounded feature and save-compatibility QA, not a full campaign or earned-economy playthrough.
